name: Dragonfly
notes: One process uses all cores. Tested in single mode with cache_mode=false, snapshots off — same durability posture as the Redis/Valkey configs.

name: Redis
threadingModel: single-threaded command execution; I/O threads optional
notes: Tested as Redis Cluster (N shards = N cores) two ways: 'cluster' = one normal cluster-mode client (realistic), 'cluster-sat' = one memtier per shard (fully driven ceiling).

name: Valkey
threadingModel: single-threaded command execution; multi-threaded I/O in 8.x
notes: Same two cluster configurations as Redis. Numbers track Redis within a few percent everywhere.

name: KeyDB
notes: Session 2 only. Refused to start above 16 server threads on this harness; plateaued before that.

name: Garnet
notes: Session 2 only. At 48 cores the CLIENT box saturated first — throughput figures are a floor ('at least'), not Garnet's ceiling. Garnet was NOT part of the memory (bytes/key) measurement.
